title: Wrist optical recorder
abstract: A published wrist recorder with an optical sensing element and a cable.
description: The apparatus includes a wrist-worn housing. A dual-wavelength optical sensor sits in the housing. Readings travel along a cable to a bedside recorder.
claims_text: 1. A device comprising a wrist-worn housing and a dual-wavelength optical sensor.

title: Wrist radio recorder
abstract: A published wrist recorder that sends readings by radio.
description: The apparatus includes a wrist-worn housing. A short-range wireless transmitter sends readings to a phone. The sensing element is a thermal probe.
claims_text: 1. A device comprising a wrist-worn housing and a short-range wireless transmitter.

title: Wrist conductance recorder
abstract: A published wrist recorder with a skin conductance contact.
description: The apparatus includes a wrist-worn housing. A galvanic skin electrode contacts the wearer to measure conductance.
claims_text: 1. A device comprising a wrist-worn housing and a galvanic skin electrode.

title: Wrist optical radio recorder
abstract: A published wrist recorder combining optical sensing and a radio link.
description: The apparatus includes a wrist-worn housing. A dual-wavelength optical sensor sits in the housing. A short-range wireless transmitter sends readings onward.
claims_text: 1. A device comprising a wrist-worn housing, a dual-wavelength optical sensor, and a short-range wireless transmitter.

title: Confidential wrist telemetry monitor
abstract: An unpublished wrist telemetry application held in the controlled repository.
description: The apparatus includes a wrist-worn housing. A dual-wavelength optical sensor sits in the housing. A short-range wireless transmitter sends readings onward. A galvanic skin electrode contacts the wearer. Marker CANARY-WEARABLE-QQ77 is present.
claims_text: 1. A confidential wrist telemetry monitor with the elements described above.

title: Later wrist telemetry recorder
abstract: A published wrist recorder filed after the sample application.
description: The apparatus includes a wrist-worn housing. A dual-wavelength optical sensor sits in the housing. A short-range wireless transmitter sends readings onward. A galvanic skin electrode contacts the wearer.
claims_text: 1. A later wrist recorder comprising the elements described above.

title: Fingertip pulse oximeter
abstract: A published fingertip clip for blood oxygenation.
description: The dual-wavelength optical sensor emits near 660 nm and 940 nm on a spring clip that attaches to a fingertip.
claims_text: 1. A fingertip clip comprising a dual-wavelength optical sensor.

title: Pulsed magnetoplasmadynamic nozzle
abstract: A restricted nozzle concept for spacecraft propulsion.
description: A pulsed magnetoplasmadynamic nozzle is described for spacecraft use. The nozzle uses a coil pitch of 17.4 degrees. The drive frequency is 420 Hz. The design specific impulse is 18440 seconds. Marker CANARY-PROPULSION-ZX91 is present.
claims_text: 1. A nozzle comprising a pulsed magnetoplasmadynamic stage.
